newsitem.title: USA: Marvel revs down due to Chapter 11 concerns.
newsitem.headline: Marvel revs down due to Chapter 11 concerns.

text.p: Marvel Entertainment Group Inc said Thursday that compared with the year ago quarter, it believes trading card and toy revenues declined due to concerns among mass market retailers related to the company's Chapter 11 proceedings.
And the company said licensing revenues declined due to similar concerns among potential licensees.
In addition, Marvel said, entertainment card and sticker revenues declined due to fewer releases and lower commercial success of third party entertainment properties.

The company said that, for the first quarter ended March 31, net revenues were $156.7 million compared with $189.6 million with a net loss of $27.8 million or ($0.27) per share compared with a net loss of $4.4 million or ($0.04) per share.
Comparisons are to the year-ago quarter.
